prompts.turn: Use the try-on image as the exact first frame, keeping the full head and body cleanly framed without cropping. Maximize preservation of the subject's exact facial details, eye-nose-mouth proportions, skin tone, hair, and likeness across every frame—strictly no face swap or identity drift. Wearing the same down jacket, the person slowly turns about 45 degrees to the side and returns to center, preserving accurate color, fit, quilting, and logos; steady camera, natural light, no distortion.
prompts.walk: Animate from the reference try-on image while keeping the full head and body proportions well framed without cropping the head. Strictly preserve and lock the person's facial features, bone structure, expression, and likeness identical to the original photo in every frame. Wearing the exact same down jacket, the person takes two natural steps forward with gentle arm swing to show drape and loft while keeping colors and garment details accurate; smooth tracking camera, stable background.
prompts.detail: Stay strictly faithful to the reference try-on image while keeping the person's head cleanly inside the frame. Maximize retention of the subject's original facial details, contours, skin texture, and likeness with zero face distortion. Gently push in toward the down jacket collar, zipper, and quilting to showcase realistic fabric texture and puffiness; subtle natural breathing only, without altering garment design or adding text.
prompts.studio: Create a clean fashion studio clip from the try-on image with the full head and outfit cleanly framed. Strictly lock and preserve the character's true facial appearance, fine features, skin tone, and hairstyle consistent with the original photo without AI beautification drift. The person stands naturally, turns slightly, and adjusts a cuff to display front and side down-jacket fit; clean background, fixed camera, soft studio lighting, smooth natural motion.
